objections.claim: Section 5(b) specifies `**` as the all-tags ruleset pattern, but GitHub ruleset patterns use `File::FNM_PATHNAME`; under those semantics `**` does not match tag names containing `/`. A listed contents:write App can therefore create a tag such as `x/malicious` and publish a release outside the claimed server-side restriction. The NON-V* regression tests only `x-malicious`, so it would not detect this bypass. Require a genuinely exhaustive tag selector/pattern and regressions for one-level and multi-level slash-containing tag names. This leaves frozen blocker 6 unresolved.
